citation: Boylan, M., Demack, S., Wolstenholme, C., Reidy, J., & Reaney, S. (2018). ScratchMaths: Evaluation report and executive summary. London: Education Endowment Foundation.
report_number: EEF project: ScratchMaths (Sheffield Hallam University evaluation, December 2018; intervention developed by UCL Institute of Education)
design: Two-armed cluster RCT (assignment = School, propensity-score-paired-school stratification within geographical hubs); 110 of 111 recruited schools randomised (55 intervention / 55 control); pupils aged 9-11 (Year 5->Year 6, grade 3-6 band); two-year computing+maths curriculum programme (ScratchMaths) supported by teacher PD (2.5 days/yr); business-as-usual / wait-list control; efficacy trial. Primary outcome = KS2 maths attainment at end of Year 6 (May 2017); interim secondary outcome = computational thinking test at end of Year 5 (July 2016).
problems: Both effect sizes are EEF/SHU cluster-randomised Hedges g = stage-2 multilevel impact coefficient divided by the standardizing SD = sqrt(total variance of the stage-0 empty multilevel model) [school + class + pupil variance components]. The report explicitly labels these 'Hedges g' (SAP-specified) but does not print the small-sample J multiplier separately; with df in the thousands J~1 so g~d. Standardizing-SD note for the primary outcome: the report's Appendix I text states SD = 23.27 from total empty-model variance, but the printed empty-model total variance is 566.1 (sqrt = 23.79); this discrepancy does not change the reported g = 0.00. impact_se recorded is the raw model coefficient SE converted to the g scale (coef SE / standardizing SD); this matches the reported 95% CI to within rounding (CI-derived SE is given in g_method). The CT (computational thinking) test was developed independently by the SHU evaluators (Bebras/Beaver-based), administered before they had access to ScratchMaths materials -> classed as researcher_made (it is an evaluator-built outcome measure, not a published standardized commercial/state test), and the ScratchMaths developer team disputed its construct validity. The CT test had heavy missing data (29 schools / ~28% of pupils missing) so an ITT approach was not fully possible; raw-sample (81 schools) result is the headline CT figure used here, complete-pairs sensitivity g = +0.12 (n.s.) noted but not extracted. Empty-model school/class ICCs recorded as the design-effect ICCs (school 0.11/0.13, class 0.01/0.02). The three KS2 maths sub-papers (Arithmetic, Reasoning 1, Reasoning 2) are recorded as subscales of the composite KS2 maths outcome. everFSM/FSM subgroup results (KS2 maths g=+0.01; CT g=+0.25) are reported in the source but NOT extracted as full-sample rows (is_full_sample handling); they are non-randomised subsets. For the meta-analysis the headline TPD-vs-control STUDENT-achievement contrast mapping to STEM is the KS2 maths primary outcome (g=0.00); the CT-test secondary is also extracted and maps to STEM (computing/maths).

effect_sizes.arm_label: ScratchMaths (single TPD arm) vs business-as-usual / wait-list control
effect_sizes.test_name: KS2 maths attainment (overall raw points, National Curriculum tests / SATs via NPD)
effect_sizes.g_method: EEF/SHU cluster-randomised Hedges g = stage-2 three-level ITT multilevel impact coefficient (Group=Intervention, b=0.06, raw KS2 maths points; model controls KS1 maths at pupil + school level) divided by standardizing SD = sqrt(empty-model total variance 566.1) = 23.79. g = 0.06/23.79 = 0.0025 ~ 0.00 (report rounds to 0.00). impact_se/g_se = model coef SE (1.471) / 23.79 = 0.0618; g_var = g_se^2 = 0.003822. Consistency check: report 95% CI (-0.12, +0.12) implies SE = 0.24/(2*1.96) = 0.0612 (g_var 0.003748).
effect_sizes.page_ref: p.5 Table 1 (exec summary); p.39 Table 12 (headline ITT); p.107 Table 40 + Appendix I (model coefficients, empty-model variance, g calculation)
effect_sizes.notes: Headline / primary confirmatory outcome (EEF security rating: very high). Overall KS2 maths is the composite that subsumes the three KS2 maths test papers (also extracted as subscales). n in model = 5,818 (2,803 intervention; 3,015 control); 110 schools, 207 classes. p = 0.970 (no evidence of impact). mean/sd are bivariate descriptive (Table 11, n=2,877/3,111). Scaled-score model gave g = +0.01 (n.s.), not extracted separately (same outcome). National Curriculum KS2 maths tests (SATs) are externally set/marked standardized assessments obtained from the National Pupil Database -> standardized_independent.

effect_sizes.arm_label: ScratchMaths (single TPD arm) vs business-as-usual / wait-list control
effect_sizes.test_name: Computational Thinking test (SHU-developed, Bebras/Beaver-based), raw score - all participants (81 schools)
effect_sizes.timepoint: interim secondary (July 2016, end of Year 5, after 1 year of intervention)
effect_sizes.g_method: EEF/SHU cluster-randomised Hedges g = stage-2 three-level multilevel impact coefficient (Group=Intervention, b=0.33, CT raw score; controls KS1 maths pupil + school) divided by standardizing SD = sqrt(empty-model total variance 4.88) = 2.209. g = 0.33/2.209 = 0.149 ~ 0.15. impact_se/g_se = coef SE (0.165)/2.209 = 0.0747; g_var = 0.005579. Consistency check: report 95% CI (+0.001, +0.29) implies SE = 0.289/(2*1.96) = 0.0737 (g_var 0.005435).
effect_sizes.page_ref: p.41 Table 15 (CT impact); p.108-109 Table 41 + Appendix I (model coefficients, empty-model variance, g calculation)
effect_sizes.notes: Interim secondary outcome measured at end of Year 1 (Year 5). Statistically significant positive effect (p=0.048) but below the analysis-stage MDES (~0.17) so estimated retrospective power only ~60%; report urges caution. Heavy missing CT data (full ITT not possible): not obtained from 29 schools incl. 11 known intervention withdrawals. n in model = 3,841 (1,778 intervention; 2,063 control); 81 schools, 162 classes. Complete-pairs sensitivity subsample (62 schools) gave g = +0.12 (95% CI -0.04, +0.29), n.s. - not extracted (sensitivity, not full sample). Test developed independently by SHU evaluators (Bebras-based), not a published standardized commercial/state test -> researcher_made; developers disputed its construct validity.
